summary: 10 Sept featured Rtn Dr Sangeeta Agrawal in conversation with Dr Amit Anand, Pulmonary and Sleep Medicine Specialist from Boston.
description:
10 Sept featured Rtn Dr Sangeeta Agrawal in conversation with Dr Amit Anand, Pulmonary and Sleep Medicine Specialist from Boston.
The evening also featured a flag exchange between President Rtn Amit Gupta and Rtn Dr Touseef Bhatt, President of the Rotary Club of Kashmir.
Dr Bhatt, widely known as the “Tree Man of Kashmir”, shared his passion for environmental conservation and community development. His dedication to protecting Kashmir’s lakes and rivers, alongside his entrepreneurial and academic contributions, added a rich dimension to the evening’s spirit of service and collaboration.
The program concluded with warm camaraderie over drinks and dinner, where members and guests continued conversations sparked during the session.
The meeting was attended by: 38 Members, 22 Partners, 2 Prospective Members and their Partners, 1 Visiting Rotarian and 1 Guest Speaker taking total attendance to 64
